eventChain: Intro: Protagonist enters a rainy night coffee shop and becomes aware of a time loop
Choice: Protagonist chooses between investigating the anomaly or protecting the companion
Result 1: Protagonist investigates clues and discovers a repeatable pattern
Result 2: Protagonist protects companion, missing the first clue but gaining trust
Ending 1: Protagonist breaks the loop and walks into a new dawn
